text: section, load region data combination individual-level summary statistics data, perform colocalization analysis using colocboost_analysis_pipeline function. colocalization analysis can run one three modes, combination modes (names assume individual-level data xQTL data summary statistics data GWAS data): xQTL-mode: perform colocalization analysis individual-level data. Summary statistics data used. joint GWAS mode: Perform colocalization analysis disease-agnostic mode individual-level summary statistics data together. separate GWAS mode: Perform colocalization analysis disease-prioritized mode individual-level data summary statistics dataset separately, treating summary statistics dataset focal trait. Inputs: region_data: List (individual_data, sumstat_data); Output load_multitask_regional_data function. focal_trait: String; xQTL-mode, name trait perform disease-prioritized ColocBoost, conditions_list_individual. provided, xQTL-mode run without disease-prioritized mode. event_filters: List character vectors; Patterns filtering events based context names. Example: sQTL, list(type_pattern = ".*clu_(\\d+_[+-?]).*", valid_pattern = "clu_(\\d+_[+-?]):PR:", exclude_pattern = "clu_(\\d+_[+-?])::"). maf_cutoff: Numeric; Minor allele frequency cutoff. Default 0.005. pip_cutoff_to_skip_ind: Integer vector; Cutoff values skipping analysis based pre-screening single-effect SuSiE (L=1). Context skipped none variants context PIP values greater cutoff. Default 0 (run single-effect SuSiE). Passing negative value sets cutoff 3/number variants. pip_cutoff_to_skip_sumstat: Integer vector; Cutoff values skipping analysis based pre-screening single-effect SuSiE (L=1). Sumstat skipped none variants sumstat PIP values greater cutoff. Default 0 (run single-effect SuSiE). Passing negative value sets cutoff 3/number variants. qc_method: String; Quality control method use. Options “rss_qc”, “dentist”, “slalom”. Default rss_qc. impute: Logical; TRUE, performs imputation outliers identified analysis. Default TRUE. impute_opts: List lists; Imputation options including rcond, R2_threshold, minimum_ld. Default list(rcond = 0.01, R2_threshold = 0.6, minimum_ld = 5). xqtl_coloc: Logical; TRUE, performs xQTL-mode. Default TRUE. joint_gwas: Logical; TRUE, performs joint GWAS mode, mapping individual-level sumstat data together.Default FALSE. separate_gwas: Logical; TRUE, runs separate GWAS mode, sumstat dataset analyzed separately individual-level data, treating sumstat focal trait disease-prioritized mode. Default FALSE. Outputs: colocboost_results: List colocboost objects (xqtl_coloc, joint_gwas, separate_gwas); Output colocboost_analysis_pipeline function. mode run, corresponding element NULL.
